entries.old_text: If a CAN signal is not received within three times its cycle time, the cluster shall treat the signal as invalid.
entries.new_text: If a CAN signal is not received for more than 500 ms, the cluster shall treat the signal as invalid.

entries.requirement_text: The cluster should wake up quickly when a door is opened.
